messages:
elaine: Hey runtime team — planning an email + blog launch next week and need a quick benchmark sanity pass for the promo model variants. Can you help with a small rerun and a short methodology check?

mike: TL;DR we need coldstart 95th/99th percentiles, embed latency for hero payloads, and quantized vs fp16 comparison. Also want sample payloads we can show in the PR (anonymized).

sam: happy to help. can you paste the exact payloads and the target model names? also what rig (gpus/region) should we prioritize?

elaine: payloads below — these are the three hero scenarios: short prompt (support reply), long context (multi-turn convo ~2k tokens), embed batch (20 short texts). model targets: rwd-1-xl-fp16, rwd-1-xl-8bit, rwd-2-base-fp16 (fallback). region: us-west1 preferred.

elaine: ```
# short prompt
{"prompt":"Summarize user's issue and suggest two troubleshooting steps."}

# long convo - send as conversation array
[ {"role":"user","content":"<500 words user message>"}, ... ]

# embed batch - 20 strings
["text1","text2", ...]
```

tara: noted. for quantized variant we need to confirm the warmup policy — do you want 30s vs 5m warmup? that changes coldstart numbers.

beth: also recommend we capture tokenization time separately for the long convo; marketing loves the headline "99th p90 on-long-context" but that can mislead if tokenization dominates.

mike: prefer conservative: run both 30s and 5m warmup for comparisons. we want to show how warmup affects tail latency. tokenization split is fine.

sam: ok we'll run three axes: variant (fp16 vs 8bit), warmup (30s vs 5m), and payload type. quick question on sample size — 200 queries per payload type should be enough for percentiles?

beth: 200 is okay for rough numbers, 1k preferred for stable 99th. for the launch deck we can show 200-sample smoke + note that 1k was run offline for validation.

elaine: timeline: need the smoke numbers and example logs by EOD Thursday. can you confirm owners and if any blockers?

sam: I'll own the smoke runs (sam). tara will validate artifacts and produce the minimal report (tara). runtime-bot: running queue established. hooking up a short trace capture for a couple of 99th outliers.

tara: small blocker — we need access to the anonymized dataset for embed batch. @mike can you confirm the set is sanitized (no PII)?

mike: confirmed — dataset sanitized, shared in marketing-drive/launch/embeds.csv. permission granted to eng-runtime.

sam: great. plan: run 200-sample smoke across the 3 payloads x 3 variants x 2 warmups = 5400 requests, capture p50/p95/p99, tokenization split, and attach a 5-sample trace for p99 outliers. will post artifacts and a 1-page summary in this thread.

elaine: perfect. please include a one-sentence caveat for the blog: "smoke sample; 99th percentiles from larger internal runs are comparable within 10%" unless you see otherwise.

tara: will validate wording. if anything looks off we'll flag and request a quick rerun (prefer <24h).

sam: starting now, ETA for smoke artifacts: Thursday 6pm PST (4770011523). will update if delayed. :rocket:
